source: OpenAI Images API (images.edit) using the matching base portrait as reference; gpt-image-2.5-flare, medium quality; Lanczos downscale to 300x600.

theme.ghoul: wasteland scavenger / Children of Atom-adjacent rags
theme.super_mutant: Super Mutant Tribe war paint and scrap armor
theme.synth: Railgut/Institute: salvaged Gen1, Railroad escapee Gen2, Courser Gen3

assets.prompt: Create an alternate portrait variant of the reference super mutant. Keep the same identity, average state, gender, pose, line weight, framing, and transparent background. Give them a tribal look: faded war-paint stripes, a scrap-metal shoulder plate, and a bone necklace. Keep the outfit and skin colours otherwise unchanged. No text, no background.
